displayTitle: Smugglers and Scoundrels: The Race for Jabba's Bounty
synopsis: Smugglers and Scoundrels: The Race for Jabba's Bounty is the first entry in the Mad Cave Studios Smugglers and Scoundrels series Race to the finish line with some of the galaxy's most infamous rascals and see who will get their hands on the treasure first! Will it be Han Solo and Chewbacca aboard the trusty Millennium Falcon? Or Han's old rival, everyone's favorite fast-talking Lepi, Jaxxon T. Tumperakki, and his lucky Rabbit's Foot? Or will it be Boba Fett, Greedo, or another competitor who takes the crown? Find out in this rip-roaring ride full of risky maneuvers, double-crosses, and questionable morals as smugglers and scoundrels from across the galaxy race to recover Jabba's prize!
title: Smugglers and Scoundrels: The Race for Jabba's Bounty
